name: ST2 Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of ST2 using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of Growth Stimulation expressed gene2 (ST2) in serum, plasma or whole blood samples. The test is used as an aid in the diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction, chronic or acute heart failure. For professional and laboratory use only.
